answer.reason: The only change is passing the mapping itself where `bool(provider_models)` was passed. `_require` treats its condition as raise-if-falsy, so an empty mapping is still rejected and a non-empty one still passes. No config can tell the two versions apart.
sources: _require(condition=provider_models, message=f"model '{model.value}' must map to a provider.")
Empty mappings and references to undeclared providers are both rejected.

review.reason: Passing a mapping directly to a condition check evaluates its truth value identically to passing its explicit boolean conversion `bool()`, making the two versions behaviorally indistinguishable.
sources: Every declared model shall map to at least one provider, and every provider referenced by a model mapping shall be present in the effective provider catalog.
_require(condition=provider_models, message=f"model '{model.value}' must map to a provider.")
